q1_top_exclusive: Find the top 5 functions by exclusive (self) sample count in incident.folded. A function's exclusive/self count is the total samples where that function is the leaf (rightmost in the semicolon-delimited stack). Aggregate across all stacks sharing the same leaf function name. Return as a list of [function_name, count] pairs sorted by count descending.
q2_top_self_delta: Find the top 5 functions with the largest increase in exclusive (self) sample count from baseline.folded to incident.folded. For functions only present in incident, their baseline count is 0. Return as a list of [function_name, delta] pairs sorted by delta descending.
q3_recursive_functions: Identify all functions that appear more than once within any single stack trace in incident.folded. A function is recursive if the same function name occurs at two or more positions in one semicolon-delimited stack. Return as a sorted list of unique function names.
q4_subsystem_distribution: Compute the percentage of total incident samples attributable to each top-level subsystem. A top-level subsystem is a direct child function of 'main' (the second element in each stack). Sum all sample counts for stacks rooted through each subsystem, divide by total samples, multiply by 100. Return as an object mapping subsystem name to percentage rounded to 2 decimal places.
q5_new_functions: Find all function names that appear anywhere in any stack in incident.folded but do not appear anywhere in any stack in baseline.folded. Return as a sorted list of unique function names.
q6_max_stack_depth: Find the maximum stack depth across all stacks in incident.folded. Stack depth is the number of function frames (semicolon-separated elements) in a single stack trace. Return as an integer.
q7_flame_width_db_acquire: Compute the flame width of function 'db_acquire' in incident.folded: the ratio of its inclusive sample count to the total sample count across all stacks. Inclusive count means the sum of sample counts for every stack where 'db_acquire' appears at any position in the call chain. Return as a float rounded to 4 decimal places.
